External links are stored separately from the other fields and cannot be updated in the same write, so `externalLinks` must be sent in a request on its own — a payload that combines it with any other field (supplier, category, note, documentNumber, documentDate, taxRate, amortization) is rejected with a 400 rather than applied partially. patch.summary: Add, change and delete expense line items
patch.description: Splits an expense into line items, or changes an existing split, in one request: `add` creates line items, `update` changes existing ones and `delete` removes them. An `update` entry changes only the fields it sends; line items the request does not name are left exactly as they are. `lineItemsVersion` must be the value from GET /expenses/{expenseId}; if the line items changed since then the request is rejected with 409 and nothing is written. After the change the line items must add up exactly to the expense total, in the expense currency, and at least 2 line items must remain. `add` and `update` together accept at most 300 line items. To split an expense into more than 300 line items, send several requests: because the total must hold after each one, keep one remainder line item and reduce its amount in each request by the amounts of the line items that request adds, using the lineItemsVersion returned by the previous response. Only expenses that are not reviewed or archived can be changed. Requires permission to view and to modify company expenses. Every rule is checked before anything is written, so a rejected request changes nothing. A rejected category, tax rate or custom field names the entry that sent it, for example `add[3].customFields[0]`.

200.description: The updated expense, including every line item and the new lineItemsVersion

400.description: Bad request: the line items do not add up to the expense total (line_items_total_mismatch), fewer than 2 line items would remain (line_items_too_few), more than 300 line items were sent, an amount has more decimals than the expense currency allows (line_item_invalid_amount), a line item is both updated and deleted (line_item_changed_and_deleted), the expense is reviewed or archived (expense_not_editable), a category or tax rate is unknown or not active (category_not_found, tax_rate_not_found), a negative tax rate cannot calculate its tax from the amount (tax_rate_not_derivable), or a custom field or its value is unknown or invalid (custom_field_not_found and the custom field value codes)
